description: Custom Minecraft launcher based on PrismLauncher, with Ely.by authentication support (Rebranded to PineconeMC)
notes: WARNING: ElyPrismLauncher has been rebranded to PineconeMC.
This manifest ('ely-prism') is deprecated and will only be maintained until 2027.
We highly recommend migrating to the new 'pineconemc' package for future updates.
Your settings, instances, and worlds will NOT be lost during this migration.
To migrate, run: scoop uninstall ely-prism && scoop install pineconemc
After install, launch PineconeMC/ElyPrismLauncher from your Start Menu or Desktop shortcut.
